text_block_list.name: Trendy Girl
text_block_list.text:
No way! Isn't that the "Villainess"!?
I'm totally taking a picture~♪

text_block_list.name: Gossip Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Ramonu! Yesterday's interview article has caused
quite a stir on social media, could you give us a comment—
As a result of stirring up the public again and again, over the past two years, the "Villainess" became the talk of the town.

As a result, she is hounded daily by aggressive journalists and onlookers,
leaving her with fewer and fewer moments of peace.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "So, a vacation?"
choice_data_list: Because I found a place where you can get plenty of rest—
Because I found a place where you can get plenty of rest—

text_block_list.name: Gossip Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Found you, Ramonu-san!
Are you going far away for some secret training!?
choice_data_list: No way! They've tracked me down already...!?
No way! They've tracked me down already...!?

text_block_list.name: Gossip Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Where are you heading off to now, miss?!?
Please answer meee!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Oh,
you're quite devoted to your work, aren't you?
choice_data_list: I'm off today! Well then, bye!

text_block_list.name: Gossip Reporter D
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Ramonuuu!
Huh, she's not here?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Giggle...
Even though uncovering secrets is your specialty—
choice_data_list: If you step too far forward, they'll spot you...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"You too.
Come closer."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
And? Where to
next—

text_block_list.name: Gossip Reporter E
text_block_list.text: Found you, Ramonu-san! Running away means you have a guilty conscience, doesn't it?!
choice_data_list: ...Ngh! Leave this to me and go on ahead!
...Ngh! Leave this to me and go on ahead!

text_block_list.name: Gossip Reporter E
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Hey!?
What gives? Stop getting in my wa—

Afterward—we somehow managed to shake off the reporters
and reach our destination.
choice_data_list: My clothes are totally ruined... But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Aah, hehe... Wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I love you...
I love you, "You," with all of my heart!

A field spreading as far as the eye can see, without a soul in sight.
With the innocent face of a young maiden, she ran as if dancing.

"To become evil for the sake of the races I love."
It was an expression I hadn't seen ever since making that resolution.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You look like you're having fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
You're always
smiling, after all.

"That applies more to you, Ramonu,"
I almost said, but stopped myself.

Mejiro Ramonu running in her Make Debut looked
as if she were crying—and that is why.
choice_data_list: I'm just glad to see you're having fun right now.
Just thinking how glad I am that you look like you're having fun right now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.
choice_data_list: I-I told you not to laugh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Because...
it's so strange.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"So devoted, you are.
With soiled clothes and a tired face."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: There wasn't a single benefit to it, and yet...
choice_data_list: It's just... I only wanted to thank you, that's all

text_block_list.text:
Because Mejiro Ramonu raised her voice, the racing world shifted, and the old passion returned.
That is why—
choice_data_list: This is a thank-you for bringing back that burning passion to racing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Gratitude.
Yes.
